evidence_state: executed source and preserved-geometry audit; no CFD run
source_notation: Source IDs conference and journal resolve to URLs, hashes and attribution in the geometry record.

selection.scope: All preserved geometry inputs and exports; conference nomenclature, Table 1, Figures 1-11 and relevant methods/results; journal geometry and uncertainty cross-check. No performance curves fitted or acceptance threshold selected.

force_xy_accuracy_N.type: factory-calibrated transducer accuracy quoted by authors

force_z_accuracy_N.type: factory-calibrated transducer accuracy quoted by authors

moment_xyz_accuracy_N_m.type: factory-calibrated transducer accuracy quoted by authors

Cpt_random.type: reported random uncertainty of total pressure coefficient
Cpt_random.source: conference p. 7 equation 4 discussion; journal section 4.2
Cpt_random.note: Method references are cited; the paper does not state a coverage factor or confidence for this number. Applies to Cpt, not CT, CP or shaft power.

pressure_acquisition_duration_s.note: Pressure sampling duration; no inference about force/torque averaging duration.

unreported: force/torque repeatability and number of independent runs
ambient pressure and temperature values/uncertainties at each point
uncertainty.propagation: If compatible standard uncertainties become available: u(P)^2 = Omega^2*u(Q)^2 + Q^2*u(Omega)^2 + 2*Q*Omega*cov(Q,Omega). Present accuracy limits cannot be substituted as standard deviations. Unknown terms remain unknown.
uncertainty.comparison: Experimental, digitization, geometry and numerical contributions remain separate; combine for the actual comparison with correlations where known. No universal CFD acceptance band follows.

reference_conditions.thrust_coefficient_source: conference Figure 6, p. 7, visual marker abscissae
reference_conditions.dimensional_total_thrust_source: conference Figure 11, p. 9, visual marker abscissae
reference_conditions.figure_merit_gain_source: conference p. 7 describes higher rotor speed; Figure 8 plots the speed sweep. This percentage is not a stated result at the pressure-profile operating point.
reference_conditions.matching_requirement: Match rotor build, RPM, clearance definition, force boundary and density convention. Nominal facility speed is not automatically a plotted reference point. Figure 7 pairs CT and CP but does not label each point by RPM; a unique RPM association must be verified before using it.

endpoints.shaft_power: P=Q*Omega, W with Q in N m; for unsteady data use mean(Q(t)*Omega(t)) over the declared interval.
endpoints.total_thrust: Measured Fz of the assembled ducted-fan rig. Reference comparison needs the same included bodies and tare convention. Support loads/tare details remain unresolved.
endpoints.component_warning: Conference p. 9 says computed rotor thrust and duct thrust. Figure 11 separates those predictions; it does not supply independently measured duct thrust. The rotor-only measurement described on p. 6 is a different configuration.

coefficients.D: casing inner diameter, not rotor diameter
coefficients.source: conference nomenclature p. 1 and equations 1-2 p. 6

endpoints.matched_thrust: For a target bracketed within one geometry and operating branch: P*=P1+(P2-P1)*(T*-T1)/(T2-T1). Interpolate each geometry separately; do not extrapolate. RPM is the adjusted input for a matched-thrust comparison.
endpoints.CFD_export_requirement: Record pressure and viscous force/moment on every included patch, rotor-axis origin/direction, moment sign and whether torque is on the rotor or fluid. Positive Q denotes shaft input. Sector scaling is allowed only for a physically repeating assembly. No exporter implemented in this task.

geometry_review.table: All station radii, printed ratios, chords and end angles visually cross-checked against both Table 1 copies. End angles do not determine a unique camber/thickness distribution.
geometry_review.tip_overlay: Existing trace overlaid on native journal Figure 2 image; no points re-picked. It follows the isolated profile within the existing operator-selected pixel allowance on visual inspection. This does not calibrate drawing fidelity.
geometry_review.frame: Exported local x runs LE to TE and positive y points to the image-upper contour; z=0. Endpoint and image-axis transformation checked independently. This does not determine rotor-axis stacking or spanwise sections.
geometry_review.figure5_correction: Scaled mesh view supplies partial duct/axial-shape information. The earlier geometry record focused only on the perspective Figure 1. Neither figure supplies full source CAD or uniquely resolves the blade root, hidden sections and assembly.
geometry_review.uncertainty: WIP pixel/endpoint allowances are chosen sensitivities, not confidence intervals. Printing precision is not manufacturing tolerance. Curve interpolation, image fidelity and three-dimensional reconstruction errors remain unquantified.

periodicity.limitation: Different sector pitches connected by a mixing interface do not demonstrate a single exact periodic repeat unit for transient seams. Retained supports, blades and seam geometry must all repeat.

feasibility.reason: One isolated tip contour plus station scalars cannot define a faithful rotor/duct assembly. No source-backed complete mesh can be built from the inspected inputs.
feasibility.compute_capacity_verdict: not measured; no resource failure or aerodynamic null inferred

preservation.formatting_disposition: Original branch retained; revised README line wrapping reused as needed. Obsolete D4 wording replaced by the activated owner direction.
